recommended_public_description: This compact support packet preserves the 2026-07-04 Noether PC/interlanguage packages 346-349 as source-canon coordination evidence. Package 346 includes CJK, interlanguage, Persianate/Tajik, Pan-Turkic, R6/R9, and Romance source-canon coordination material, including 50 TeX-like Spanish mathematical source files from the ES-B-002_notas-san-salvador probe tree. Packages 347-349 add continuation ledgers, CJK revalidation, non-Slavic consolidation, Arabic/Persianate pointer and policy-sync probes, R6/R7/R9 source-canon alignment, and relation-function support notes. It should be used as methodology/workflow evidence for the interlanguage record, not as translation completion, complete source-body capture, approval, or publication readiness.
